refuted.reason: The public Stripe OpenAPI supports file create, retrieve and list, but no file delete.
The public schema has no service integration DELETE; use the separately scoped Event Orchestration integration operation.
The verified member removal API is team scoped, not site scoped.
No public token revoke operation was verified; a build hook delete replaces this candidate.
The public API deletes one submission; this batch uses the singular operation rather than claiming a bulk API.
Archive overlaps the existing notion.page.delete operation, so it is not counted as a new entry.

reviewNotes: Read-only official API schemas, vendor reference pages and vendor SDK source were checked by two vendor-group refuters. This is not two independent reviews per entry and does not prove live connector execution.
Opsgenie human API pages returned HTTP 429; official public SDK source verified the included operations instead.
Basecamp API documentation says projects in trash are deleted after 30 days, but current help says 25 days or when trash is emptied. No fixed trash retention duration is promised by these cases.
Cloudflare zone deletion was already in the registry and is not counted as a new entry.
A registry entry describes a canonical tool surface. It does not imply that VOID supplies a connector or that a manual administration action has a public API endpoint.
